code_full:
function getStn2CalValues() {

  const c = HMI_STATE.stn2.calibration;

  return {

    acErr: Number(c.acErr ?? 7.0),

    dcErr: Number(c.dcErr ?? 1),

    spkErr: Number(c.spkErr ?? 20),

    direction: c.direction || 'Forward',

    brakeType: c.brakeType || 'Powder Brake',

    encoderPprSet: Number(c.encoderPprSet ?? 5000),

    encoderPprActual: Number(c.encoderPprActual ?? 5000),

    markOffset: Number(c.markOffset ?? 0),

    cylinderCircumference: Number(c.cylinderCircumference ?? 1570),

    b2bAlarm: Number(c.b2bAlarm ?? 15),

    markSkipAlarm: Number(c.markSkipAlarm ?? 6),

    brakePower: Number(c.brakePower ?? 50),

    brakeCapacity: Number(c.brakeCapacity ?? 20),

    brakeCurrent: Number(c.brakeCurrent ?? 0.0),

    brakeCurrentCal: Number(c.brakeCurrentCal ?? 14160),

    setTension: Number(c.setTension ?? (HMI_STATE.stn1?.sTension || HMI_STATE.recipe?.sTensionTarget || 5.0))

  };

}
